boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase outings around Syracuse, including public galleries, canal history, outdoor swimming, and neighborhood spray features.

cards.title: Browse the Warehouse Gallery
cards.subtitle: A free downtown art hang
cards.notes: Bring a friend to browse the changing exhibitions, then compare favorite works before leaving the Nancy Cantor Warehouse.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary art in a public gallery with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University states that the Warehouse Gallery is free and open to the public and publishes current academic-year and summer hours.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. Summer hours are Thursday through Saturday, noon–6 p.m.; academic-year hours vary by day.

cards.title: See Photography at Light Work
cards.subtitle: Free galleries near the Syracuse University quad
cards.notes: Meet at the Menschel Media Center and explore the photography exhibitions together during a weekday afternoon opening.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost photography-focused gallery visit near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Light Work states that its galleries are free and open to the public and lists their location and current operating hours.
cards.access_notes: The galleries are free and open to the public Monday–Thursday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; call ahead to confirm opening during university breaks.

cards.title: Explore the Erie Canal Museum
cards.subtitle: Free history inside the 1850 Weighlock Building
cards.notes: Walk through the permanent canal exhibition with friends and inspect the historic weighlock building without buying admission.
cards.short_summary: Canal artifacts and Syracuse history in a free museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Erie Canal Museum states that it is open seven days a week with free admission.
cards.access_notes: Open seven days a week with free admission; consult the museum’s visiting information before setting out.

cards.title: Swim Laps at Thornden Pool
cards.subtitle: Free seasonal open swim near the university district
cards.notes: Pack a swimsuit and meet for open swim; use the designated lap lane if your group wants a structured workout together.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal swim in Thornden Park’s 50-meter pool.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse says its outdoor pools offer free open swim from mid-June to mid-August and identifies Thornden Park Pool as a participating facility.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: Seasonal free open swim is typically Monday–Saturday, noon–7 p.m., and Sunday, 1–7 p.m.; modified schedules and closures may apply.

cards.title: Cool Off at Upper Onondaga Pool
cards.subtitle: Free summer open swim on Roberts Avenue
cards.notes: Gather a small group for an afternoon swim, checking the city cancellation notice before traveling across Syracuse.
cards.short_summary: No-admission summer swimming in Upper Onondaga Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse lists Upper Onondaga Park Pool among its outdoor pools and states that outdoor-pool open swim is free.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: Seasonal free open swim generally runs mid-June to mid-August; review posted schedules, swim rules, and cancellation notices first.

cards.title: Take a Free Swim at Wilson Park
cards.subtitle: A neighborhood pool hang without an entry fee
cards.notes: Plan a relaxed open-swim meetup at the 25-yard pool and arrive early because operating schedules can change with staffing.
cards.short_summary: A compact city-pool outing that requires no admission purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse identifies Wilson Park Pool and says open swim at the city’s outdoor pools operates free of charge.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: Free open swim is seasonal, typically mid-June through mid-August; check current closures, capacity rules, and modified weekday hours.

cards.title: Cool Down at Skiddy Park
cards.subtitle: A free seasonal spray-feature meetup
cards.notes: Choose a hot afternoon, bring water and sun protection, and meet beside the playground for a casual outdoor cooldown.
cards.short_summary: A simple warm-weather hang centered on a free park mister.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse says its spray features are free to use and lists the Skiddy Park Spray Mister near the playground.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: The city describes spray features as free and typically available from Memorial Day through Labor Day; operation is seasonal.

cards.title: Meet at Sunnycrest’s Spray Mister
cards.subtitle: A self-activated free cooldown
cards.notes: Pair the self-activated mister with an easy park meetup, and confirm seasonal operation before heading to Sunnycrest.
cards.short_summary: Free self-serve water play at a named city park feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse lists Sunnycrest Park’s self-activated spray mister and states that city spray features are free to use.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: Free, self-activated, and seasonal; city guidance says spray features are typically available Memorial Day through Labor Day.

cards.title: Take a Spray Break at Thornden Park
cards.subtitle: Free water play just outside the pool
cards.notes: Meet outside the pool for a quick cooldown, then use Thornden Park’s green space for conversation or a relaxed walk.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket alternative to a full pool outing at Thornden Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse lists the Thornden Park Spray Feature outside the pool and says city spray features are free to use.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is required. The spray feature is seasonal and typically available from Memorial Day through Labor Day.

cards.title: Cool Off at Union Park
cards.subtitle: A free spray-feature hang beside the playground
cards.notes: Bring a towel and meet beside the playground for a low-key summer break that does not require tickets or reservations.
cards.short_summary: Seasonal outdoor water play with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Syracuse identifies the Union Park Spray Feature beside the playground and states that its spray features are free to use.
cards.source_title: Swimming & Spray Features - City of Syracuse
cards.access_notes: Free and seasonal; the city says spray features are typically available from Memorial Day through Labor Day.
